description: The upload levers of the host KV tier's host side (docs/tp4-upload1.md): QWEN_PREFIX_TIER_IO_THREADS (threaded, pipelined staging copies of the raw block IO, qwen_tier_upload.ThreadedTierIO), QWEN_PREFIX_TIER_IO_CHUNK_BLOCKS (the device call size, a sweep knob) and QWEN_PREFIX_TIER_VERIFY_THREADS (the digest checks of a restore's records on worker threads). They change how long the same bytes take to move, never which bytes.

notes: Like the sliced restore (TS): the levers are derived onto any tier profile by the prefix gate (DERIVED['upload1']), so there is no profile twin; a traffic profile may name them only under a waiver that names the tier (serving_c2_contract.prefix_policy_problems).
